data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gynnos', meaning 'born of Jupiter'. This name evokes images of strength, courage, and faith in the face of adversity. The name Gintz carries the meaning “Divine warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gintz usually hope their child will grow to embody divine warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
